name: Milky Touch
source: Welcome to Milky Town. Yesterday, you were just another young man about to start your first day at a private university. However, today everything is about to change. Your future during this new school year will be embroiled in sneaky plots and surprising twists around both the university and the town itself. Fortunately, just about all of these events will include a number of bodacious women that you’ll have a chance to ‘work closely’ during your adventure.​
translation: 欢迎来到牛奶镇。昨天，你还只是一个即将在私立大学迎来开学第一天的普通年轻人。然而今天，一切都将改变。在这个新学年里，你的未来将被卷入校园与小镇内的阴谋和意想不到的变故。好在，这些事件几乎都少不了身材火辣的女人，而在冒险途中，你将有机会与她们“亲密合作”。
